verdict.rationale: Cloud Agents docs confirm multi-repo sessions ('up to 20 repos', 'inspect the full workspace, make coordinated changes, and open pull requests in the repos it changes'), which supports including multiple project directories/repos in one session, but this is scoped to Cloud Agents rather than a general local-editor session feature, and no explicit local-IDE 'multi-root workspace' or multi-folder context capability is documented. missing for 10: explicit local/editor-session multi-directory context support, independent/hands-on confirmation of multi-repo context actually broadening understanding, and details on how cross-repo context is unified for search/chat.
